text: Cutting wages is the easiest and most slovenly way to handle the situation, not to speak of its being an inhuman way. It is, in effect, throwing upon labour the incompetency of the managers of the business. If we only knew it, every depression is a challenge to every manufacturer to put more brains into his business.
author: Henry Ford
reference: My Life and Work (with Samuel Crowther)
locator: Chapter IX, Why Not Always Have Good Business?
